The process changes faster than the building
IAQ company profile
The solar industry is constantly evolving, with new materials and technologies emerging regularly.

Silicon, cadmium and silver each come with environmental and health requirements that shape the design. Safe handling is built into the facility at design stage, alongside the local regulations that govern the site, so the controls are part of the building itself.

1

3

4
Optimised energy output and efficiency
One accountable team, every system

Solar panel manufacturing works with materials such as silicon, cadmium and silver, and IAQ carries the environmental and health controls for handling them safely through design and construction.

IAQ brings expertise in solar technology and local regulations, a commitment to optimising energy output and efficiency, and experience managing toxic materials and waste. Together they deliver reliable, efficient facilities for solar panel manufacturing.

4

Solar plants change process faster than most sectors, so design and procurement are run to keep the facility able to take the next generation of tooling.

Classified where the process needs it

The published module plant runs at ISO 6, Class 1K, and solar cell production is recorded at ISO 8, Class 100K. Where the process does not need a classified environment, the record shows Not Applicable and the control effort moves to materials handling and waste instead.
